title: Quantum Informatics CDT (2027/28 entry, Cohort 3)
institution: Quantum Informatics Centre for Doctoral Training (University of Edinburgh)
about: The Quantum Informatics Centre for Doctoral Training is recruiting Cohort 3 for 2027/28 entry, with applications through the University of Edinburgh. Applications opened in October 2026 and close 7 January 2027; interviews are in late March and offers in mid-April 2027.
requirements: At minimum a UK first-class or upper second-class (2:1) honours degree, or equivalent, in a relevant subject
Applications through the University of Edinburgh's EUCLID system
